system.description:
At the start of combat, select one of the four Ammunitions to Chamber. Each Ammunition is attributed a number between 1 and 4. All attacks you make will benefit from your Chambered Ammunition. After you make a Focused Attack your Chambered Ammunition number increases by 1, automatically changing your Chambered Ammunition to the corresponding number and resetting back to 1 after it reaches 4.

  1. Full Metal: Deal additional damage equal to 4.
  2. Boat Tail: This attack has a +4 increased range.
  3. Soft Point: Your Soul Armaments range is reduced by 2 (Min. 1) for this attack but it increases your Attack Roll by the same amount.
  4. Trick Shot: After this attack you can Dash up to 2 Spaces in any direction.
